an3.32:1.1: kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.32:5.1: Idañ ca pana me taṃ Ānanda sandhāya bhāsitaṃ Pārāyane Puṇṇakapañhe:
an3.32:6.1: Saṅkhāya lokasmiṃ parovarāni Yass' iñjitaṃ n' atthi kuhiñci loke Santo vidhūmo anigho nirāso Atāri so jātijaran ti brūmī ti. Atha
